main_body: Grey steel safe: light top band, edge highlight and shadow row, then a front face with an inset door panel and a gold dial and handle
top_band: light grey #a3acb5 rows 10-12 (3 rows), then a lighter front-edge line at row 13 (#d0d8e0)
evidence: The column at x=8 reads: dark outline (row 9), top band (rows 10-12), light front-edge line (row 13), darker eave shadow (rows 14-15), dark outline (row 16), then the front face. The front face carries a dark-outlined inset door panel with a dial, so the construction matches the green cabinet in the guide. The top is only 3 rows and is the same grey as the side margins of the front, but the edge line and eave shadow separate it clearly. This is a thin but valid foreshortened top, so it passes.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours, against 38-40 in the references, and a median of 10 colours per tile against 17-20. 100% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a uniform near-black line (#22282e) in the sticker look, while the references use tinted outlines. The grey ramp has only about 4 steps and carries no grain or speckle. The 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%, but only because the piece is small and its panel is split into narrow bands, so that does not offset the shallow shading and neutral outline.
